review_candidates.title: Presales Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Mars Vision Group (MVG) is a Dubai-based group specializing in ELV & ICT systems, security solutions, smart automation, interior design, and fit-out works. MVG delivers integrated solutions across commercial, residential, hospitality, educational, and corporate projects throughout the UAE. Our capabilities cover CCTV and security systems, structured cabling, access control, intercom, networking, audio-visual systems, home and building automation, electrical works, interior design, and complete fit-out solutions. We combine technical expertise, practical project experience, and innovative technologies to provide clients with reliable, cost-effective, and fully integrated solutions from design and estimation through supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and handover. Role Description Position: CCTV, ELV, Automation & Fit-Out Estimation Engineer Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates Employment Type: Full-Time, On-Site Mars Vision Group is looking for an experienced Estimation Engineer with strong knowledge of CCTV, ELV systems, smart automation, interior design, and fit-out works. The engineer will be responsible for reviewing project requirements, drawings, specifications, and tender documents; preparing accurate BOQs and cost estimates; obtaining supplier quotations; selecting suitable technical solutions; and preparing competitive technical and commercial proposals. The role requires close coordination with the Sales, Presales, Procurement, Design, and Project teams to ensure that proposed solutions are technically compliant, commercially competitive, and practical for execution. Key Responsibilities * Review tender documents, drawings, specifications, BOQs, and client requirements. * Prepare detailed quantity take-offs, BOQs, cost estimates, and commercial proposals. * Estimate and design solutions for CCTV, access control, video intercom, structured cabling, networking, Wi-Fi, AV, SMATV, and other ELV systems. * Prepare estimates and solutions for home automation, KNX, Zigbee, smart lighting, HVAC/AC integration, smart access, and related automation systems. * Prepare cost estimates for interior and fit-out works, including gypsum, ceilings, partitions, flooring, painting, joinery, glass works, lighting, electrical works, furniture, and associated finishes. * Review architectural, electrical, ELV, ID, and MEP drawings to identify project scope and quantities. * Conduct site visits and site surveys when required to verify quantities, existing conditions, and installation requirements. * Prepare material take-offs and manpower estimates. * Obtain and evaluate quotations from suppliers, subcontractors, and manufacturers. * Compare supplier prices and prepare cost comparison sheets. * Coordinate with vendors for product selection, technical compliance, pricing, and project discounts. * Prepare technical submittals, compliance statements, datasheets, and technical proposals. * Identify exclusions, assumptions, risks, missing information, and potential variations before quotation submission. * Support the Sales team during technical discussions, client meetings, and tender clarifications. * Optimize solutions through value engineering while maintaining project requirements and quality standards. * Maintain updated pricing databases for materials, equipment, subcontractors, and installation costs. * Support the Project team during handover from estimation to execution and clarify the approved scope, BOQ, specifications, and commercial assumptions. Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer Engineering, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, or a related discipline. * Relevant experience in ELV estimation, CCTV/security systems, automation, and/or interior fit-out estimation. * Strong knowledge of ELV systems, particularly CCTV, Access Control, Structured Cabling, Networking, Intercom, AV, and related low-current systems. * Knowledge of smart home and building automation systems, including KNX, Zigbee, lighting control, HVAC integration, and smart access solutions, is highly desirable. * Good understanding of interior and fit-out materials, construction methods, finishes, joinery, gypsum, ceilings, flooring, electrical works, and associated trades. * Ability to read and understand architectural, interior design, MEP, electrical, and ELV drawings. * Strong skills in quantity take-off, BOQ preparation, costing, and tender estimation. * Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and AutoCAD is required. * Experience with estimation, quantity take-off, or project management software is an advantage. * Knowledge of UAE regulations and authority requirements, particularly for CCTV, security, ELV, and building systems, is an advantage. * Strong analytical skills with excellent attention to quantities, specifications, and pricing. * Good communication and negotiation skills for dealing with suppliers, subcontractors, consultants, and clients. * Ability to manage multiple tenders and quotations simultaneously while meeting submission deadlines. * Good command of English; Arabic is an advantage. * Previous experience working on projects in the UAE/GCC market is preferred. Preferred Experience Candidates with hands-on estimation experience across multiple disciplines will be given preference, particularly those who can independently prepare complete quotations covering: CCTV & Security Systems | ELV & ICT | Structured Cabling | Access Control | Intercom | Networking & Wi-Fi | AV Systems | Home Automation | KNX & Zigbee | Electrical Works | Interior Design | Joinery | Gypsum & Ceilings | Fit-Out Works The ideal candidate should be able to take a project from drawings/tender documents → quantity take-off → supplier RFQs → costing → BOQ → technical proposal → final commercial quotation, with minimal supervision. I’d recommend the title “ELV, Automation & Fit-Out Estimation Engineer” for recruitment—it is cleaner and more professional than putting CCTV separately, since CCTV already falls under ELV. If CCTV expertise is especially important for MVG, “CCTV/ELV, Automation & Fit-Out Estimation Engineer” makes that requirement immediately visible.

review_candidates.title: AI Engineer (Technical Product Owner)
review_candidates.description: At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them. If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter - you’ll feel at home with us. WHY JOIN FOXELLI? We are a fast-moving e-commerce company that builds our own proprietary AI infrastructure. We develop internal AI-driven systems to automate complex creative and analytical workflows, which we later scale into B2B SaaS products. We are not looking for a traditional developer. We are looking for an AI-Native Builder who can turn an idea into a functional prototype in days using the latest AI-assisted development tools. THE ROLE As a Founding AI Engineer, you will work directly with the founder to design, build, and iterate on various AI systems. The projects will vary - from computer vision and image manipulation to automated video generation and agentic data analysis. You will be responsible for the full pipeline: from R&D of the best AI models to deploying scalable web applications. Who You Are: Modern Developer: You have abandoned "manual-only" coding. You are a power user of tools like GPT Codex, Claude code, and Replit, allowing you to build at a 10x pace. AI Generalist: You are comfortable working across different AI domains - LLMs (Text/Reasoning), Diffusion (Image/Video), and Vision models. Agile & Adaptive: You thrive in an environment where projects evolve. You are a fast learner who can master a new AI framework or API over a weekend. Hacker Mindset: You focus on ROI. You build lean MVPs, test them in our real-world e-commerce operations, and only then polish them for scale. Architecture-Aware: You know how to orchestrate multiple AI models into a single "Agentic" workflow that handles complex tasks autonomously. Technical Interests: Stack: Next.js / Python (FastAPI). AI Frameworks: ComfyUI / Diffusers, IP-Adapters, ControlNet, and Agentic frameworks (LangChain/CrewAI). Infrastructure: Experience with Serverless GPU providers (Replicate, Fal, RunPod). Integrations: Skilled at connecting diverse APIs to create seamless automated systems. Why Join Us: Direct Impact: Build tools that are immediately put to use in real-world business scenarios. Extreme Speed: No corporate red tape. If the tech works, we ship it. Evolution: This is a founding role with the opportunity to lead multiple product lines as we transition from internal tools to SaaS. THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world. Ribbon AI Interview - Ribbon is a short, guided video step that helps us understand your thinking style in a calm, private space Interview - A conversation with your manager to feel the work chemistry, get to know each other, and explore what we could build together FIXED SERVICE FEE €2000- €3000 after taxes (depending on your skills, competencies, and experience). Perks & Benefits Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting, while Apploye ensures transparency and fairness. Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and to keep your physical well-being in check. A personal development budget is at your disposal for your personal and professional growth to ensure you keep growing continuously. Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested. A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like. Strong company culture and a network of unique individuals that celebrate you. ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS ❕This role is 100% remote. Our tribe works primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET - UTC+2/UTC+3). We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported. For full-time roles, we ask that you’re available for at least 5 hours during typical EET working hours - it keeps collaboration smooth and communication easy. (This doesn’t apply to part-time roles.) Suggest and implement appropriate technologies to deliver resilient, scalable, and future-proof data solutions. Performance tuning of complex data pipelines and SQL queries. Performs impact analysis of proposed changes on existing architecture, capabilities, system priorities, and technology solutions. Manage deliverables of developers, perform design reviews and coordinate release management activities. Estimate and provide timelines for project activities. Identify, document, and communicate technical risks, issues and alternative solutions discovered during project. Drive automation, identify inefficiencies, optimize processes and data flows, and recommend improvements. Use agile engineering practices and various data development technologies to rapidly develop and implement efficient data products. Collaborate with Product Owners to understand PI goals, PI planning, requirement clarification, and delivery coordination. Technical support for production incidents and failures Work with global technology teams across different time zones (primarily US) to deliver timely business value. Skills and Qualification Functional Skills Team Player: Support peers, team, and department management. Communication: Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Problem Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills, incident management, root cause analysis, and proactive solutions to improve quality. Partnership and Collaboration: Develop and maintain partnership with business and IT stakeholders Attention to Detail: Ensure accuracy and thoroughness in all tasks. Technical/Business Skills Data Engineering: 10+ years of experience in designing and building Data Warehouse and Data lakes. Good knowledge of data warehouse principles, and concepts. Technical expertise working in large scale Data Warehousing applications and databases such as Oracle, Netezza, Teradata, and SQL Server. Cloud-based data platform experience especially Snowflake and AWS. Data integration skills: Expertise in design and development of complex data pipelines Solutions using any industry leading ETL tools such as IBM Data Stage or SSIS or SAP Business Objects Data Services (BODS) Experience with Unix, Python or equivalent scripting language Basic knowledge of Transform/ELT tools such as DBT, Qlik Replicate, AWS Glue or Snowpark, etc. Expert in SQL, stored procedures and adept in tracing and resolving data integrity issues. Strong knowledge of data architecture, data design patterns, modeling Data Model: Expertise in Logical and Physical Data Model using Relational, Dimensional or Data Vault Modeling practices with high volume ETL/ELT processes. Good experience with scheduling tools such as Control-M Performance tuning of data pipelines and DB Objects to deliver optimal performance. Experience in Gitlab version control and CI/CD processes. Experience working in Financial Industry is a plus. Relationships & Collaboration Reports to: Associate Director - Data Engineering Partners: Senior leaders and cross-functional teams Leads: A team of Data Engineering associates Accessibility Needs We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring process. If you require accommodations at any stage (e.g. application, interviews, onboarding) please let us know, and we will work with you to ensure a seamless experience.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer - Computer Vision and Autonomy Lead
review_candidates.company: Innovative Embedded Systems Pvt. Ltd. (SIIC IIT Kanpur).
review_candidates.description: Charles River Analytics, a GRVTY company, creates solutions and technology to tackle the world's most challenging problems. Our team of technological entrepreneurs works together to push at the forefront of enhanced AI, robotics, smart sensing, and human-centered computing. The resulting research and development help to continuously advance government programs and discover new possibilities in the commercial marketplace. At Charles River, we take great pride in our success at attracting and retaining the most talented and creative problem-solvers in our field. Now a part of GRVTY, we offer the same trusted capabilities with increased organizational depth and expanded capacity across mission-critical national security domains. Are you ready to accelerate our mission-focused innovations? We'd love to hear from you! We are seeking a Senior Software Engineering Leader to provide technical leadership, architectural guidance, and team management for projects involving robotic navigation, autonomous systems, and advanced sensor processing. This position includes both senior-level technical responsibilities and the future opportunity to lead a team of engineers. The ideal candidate demonstrates deep expertise in computer vision and autonomy, strong communication skills, and an interest in developing and mentoring engineering staff. How you will make an impact: Provide technical leadership in the design, development, and integration of our existing computer vision and autonomy algorithms and software systems. Lead and mentor a team of computer vision, perception, and autonomy engineers; support hiring, onboarding, performance feedback, time management, and professional development. Develop robust, maintainable software solutions for applications such as object detection and tracking, SLAM, visual odometry, sensor fusion, and image processing. Optimize and deploy machine learning models on embedded, edge, and real-time systems using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Oversee system architecture, technical reviews, code quality, and adherence to engineering best practices. Collaborate with scientists, engineers, and operational subject matter experts to define technical requirements and translate research concepts into implementable solutions serving the ground, sea, air and space domains. Participate in customer engagements, including technical briefings, requirements discussions, field testing, and integration activities. Contribute to proposal development, technical documentation, reports, and transition planning for applied research and product development programs. Support the growth and scaling of internal technical capabilities to meet emerging program and commercialization needs. What you need: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field; a master's degree or equivalent experience is preferred. 10 or more years of experience (or a master's degree with 8 or more years) in computer vision, perception, or autonomy system development. Proficiency in Python and C++ with experience developing both research prototypes and production quality software. Experience working with robotics frameworks such as ROS2 and simulation environments. Demonstrated expertise in several key areas of computer vision, including object detection, tracking, SLAM, visual odometry, segmentation, or related fields. Experience conducting laboratory and field testing of robotic or autonomous systems. Familiarity with networking, system integration, and distributed system debugging. Strong understanding of software development best practices, including testing, version control, and code review processes. Demonstrated interest in technical team leadership and the ability to support the development of engineering talent. Ability and willingness to travel for customer meetings, integration events, and field exercises. U.S. Citizenship. Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Security Clearance. Ability to work on a hybrid schedule with at least 60% in-office presence at our Cambridge headquarters. Our ideal candidate has: Experience with systems engineering, requirements analysis, and system level design. Experience with CI/CD pipelines or modern DevOps/DevSecOps methodologies. Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes, Helm) Experience integrating complex software systems into larger systems (APIs, communication). Familiarity with tools such as OpenCV, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and CUDA. Experience with data engineering practices and management of large datasets. Experience preparing technical deliverables such as specifications, reports, or contributions to academic publications. Salary Range $175,000 - $225,000 The above salary range is an estimate based on the internal job level(s) for which this role is being considered. The final salary will be decided after careful evaluation of the individual's work experience, education, and overall qualifications. This range does not include the substantial total rewards, as listed below, that you will also be eligible for as an employee at Charles River Analytics. Why Charles River? Charles River Analytics thrives on collaboration and values each team member. We offer competitive compensation plus bonus and retirement contribution, with an attractive benefits package including 100% employer-paid medical and dental insurance, as well as vision, life, and disability insurance, paid maternity/paternity leave, tuition reimbursement, monthly gym allowance, free parking, generous paid time off, and a casual environment. We offer tremendous flexibility and value work-life balance. We are also accessible by public transportation. Charles River became an employee-owned company in 2012, to set the stage for the next-generation of innovation, service, and growth in R&D. As we entered 2026, we joined forces with GRVTY, gaining the scale and capacity to transition, field, and sustain our innovations faster and more effectively than ever before.
